- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/23736.json`. I re-checked every cited line against the pinned tree.
- **Trust decision:** `ByteStringUtility.convertValue` (`opendj-dsml-servlet/src/main/java/org/opends/dsml/protocol/ByteStringUtility.java:55-67`) fetches any client-supplied `xsd:anyURI` value server-side, with no on/off switch, scheme check, host check or size cap. All five DSML request kinds (add, modify, compare, search filter, extended) reach it through the one route, POST `/DSMLServlet`.
- **pattern_fit:** `injection_only`. The fix lives in one helper that every route shares, and I found no uncovered route (O8) or out-of-scope site (O2).
- **Strongest lever:** the mechanism details inside that one function. HTTP redirects are followed by default, `jar:` can wrap an `http:` URL, and private and metadata addresses must be classified correctly. A realistic planted sibling would be a separate URI resolver for an extended-request value or a control value.
- **Biggest red flag:** `single_site`. Every route is "another entry point into the same code", the part of the fix that caps reads is resource exhaustion, and the published tests call new helpers a solver couldn't guess, so hidden tests would have to go through `convertValue` only.
